title: Bank holiday on Janmashtami: Where are banks closed on Sept 4, 2026? Check list

Customers should be aware that further closures will occur throughout the month for additional festivals and elections. It's essential to check local holiday schedules for branch services, although digital banking and ATMs will continue to function normally. Plan accordingly for any urgent in-person banking needs during these times.

Upon arrival, officers discovered his lifeless body on the bed, accompanied by noticeable signs of blood. Disturbingly, Singh had been out of touch with his family for several days. This shocking discovery occurs shortly after the murder of another regional music artist, Ankit Balyan.

Seventy roles are also being cut from the company's Sunnyvale office. This follows widespread corporate downsizing across Amazon's white-collar workforce. Other tech firms like Synopsys are also trimming their employee numbers.

title: 5 migrants dead after boat carrying over 100 people drifts for weeks in Atlantic
description: At least five African migrants died after their boat encountered trouble at sea. Forty-four survivors were rescued and brought to safety near Gran Canaria. Survivors reported being adrift for nearly a month without provisions. Many migrants suffered dehydration and illness after drinking seawater. The Atlantic route to the Canary Islands remains a dangerous journey.

Meet Pankaj Kamboj, who turned repeated defence exam setbacks into CAPF success
description: UPSC success story: Pankaj Kamboj’s journey to clearing the UPSC CAPF Assistant Commandant examination is marked by repeated setbacks across competitive exams. After failing UPSC CSE Prelims three times and facing several SSB rejections, he continued preparing through self-study while clearing CDS and AFCAT multiple times. Coming from a farming family near the Uttar Pradesh-Uttarakhand border, Kamboj credits his mother for motivating him. He has now cleared CAPF while continuing his UPSC Civil Services journey after clearing Prelims on his fourth attempt.

title: Retired Kodak worker picked moss from New York log and discovered new animal
description: A retired Kodak finance worker and longtime volunteer, Judy Dobles, discovered a previously unknown tardigrade species after collecting moss from a log at New York’s Cumming Nature Center and examining it under a microscope. The species was formally recognised about a year later. Named Mesocrista ojagwaji, it adds to the growing list of tardigrades identified in New York and highlights how much microscopic life remains to be studied.

title: US draws a red line on PM Modi’s Iran meeting
Yamunanagar woman stabbed multiple times by neighbour in front of 4-year-old son, dies
description: A 26-year-old woman died after a neighbour allegedly attacked her with a knife. The accused reportedly followed her into a house and inflicted multiple stab wounds. Police registered a murder case against the neighbour, identified as Sajan. The victim's husband stated the accused had prior disputes with the family. Authorities are actively searching for the absconding accused.

title: Scientists warmed peat bog by up to 9C; carbon storage flipped to emissions
description: Peatlands, which store significant global soil carbon, are now releasing it.  Warming temperatures cause these ecosystems to shift from carbon accumulators to emitters.  This transition occurs rapidly, even with modest warming of four degrees Fahrenheit.  Researchers observed carbon loss rates significantly faster than historical accumulation rates.  These findings impact global climate forecasting models and future predictions.

He shared that Agarkar was traveling and encountered connectivity problems that prevented him from joining virtually. Saikia also brushed aside any rumors about adjustments to the senior men's selection committee. The meeting primarily reviewed past performances and strategized for the upcoming 2027 ODI World Cup without addressing the potential appointment of a cricket director.

This dismissal highlighted Chahal's impressive performance for Northamptonshire.

7.8% growth, but a Rs 6 lakh crore question: Why GDP data has sparked a debate
description: One of the biggest points of discussion and questioning is the revision to Q1 FY26 GDP at current prices, that is the figures for last year's same quarter numbers. Under the old 2011-12 series, GDP was estimated at Rs 86.05 lakh crore. However, under the new series, it has subsequently been revised to Rs 80 lakh crore.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes feed 125 Kansas City families: How are they giving back?
description: Dedicated to enhancing the lives of Kansas City families, the Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ foundation offers vital food resources through impactful partnerships. Last Thanksgiving, their efforts resulted in over 200 families receiving festive meal packages. Moreover, the foundation has prioritized food allergy education with a unique back-to-school event, reinforcing their commitment to community health and ensuring everyone has access to nutritious food.

title: ‘Akash Anand needs to become more mature’: Mayawati rules out major BSP role for nephew
description: In her recent remarks, Mayawati emphasized that Akash Anand needs greater political maturity to assume significant roles within the party. She reaffirmed that the Bahujan Samaj Party intends to independently contest all upcoming elections nationwide. Additionally, she labeled the Congress party as distinctly anti-Dalit and anti-Ambedkar, and critiqued the RSS for inconsistencies between their rhetoric and actions.

title: Bihar man lured to Delhi over old rivalry, shot dead; 8 held after 12,000-km chase
description: A Bihar resident was lured to Delhi and shot dead over an old rivalry. Eight individuals were arrested across multiple states following a large interstate operation. The victim was allegedly killed in a rented premises in southeast Delhi's Pul Prahladpur. Police investigations revealed a conspiracy involving several associates of the main accused. Efforts continue to recover remaining firearms and identify other potential accomplices.

title: 'Govt aid would stop': Bengal CM warns schools over Vande Mataram compliance
description: West Bengal's Chief Minister warned schools about financial aid cuts for not singing Vande Mataram. He criticized past governments for allegedly destroying the education system and distorting curricula. The Chief Minister stated reforms are underway to restore Indian culture and nationalist values in schools. He also accused the previous government of banning the National Cadet Corps in educational institutions.

title: ‘What more do you want?’: BCCI secy’s blunt message on Rohit Sharma speculation
description: BCCI secretary Devajit Saikia defended Rohit Sharma's continued high-level performance in ODIs. He questioned the ongoing speculation regarding the veteran player's future in the team. Sharma himself has previously stated that external noise does not significantly impact his focus. The board's stance comes as the 2027 ODI World Cup approaches. India will eventually need to consider succession planning for the team.

title: Ajay Devgn, Tiger Shroff respond to FDA's notice for elaichi ad, SRK's reply awaited
description: Ajay Devgn and Tiger Shroff have both responded to the notice issued by the Maharashtra FDA, while the wait continues for Shah Rukh Khan's reply. The notice raised concerns about the elaichi advertisement, suggesting it may be promoting Vimal Pan Masala, a product that is banned in Maharashtra. Further developments from the FDA are expected after Khan provides his response.

title: ‘Diversity is true beauty of society’: B'desh PM extends Janmashtami greetings
description: Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman extended Janmashtami greetings to the Hindu community. He stated that the country belongs to all citizens, who enjoy equal rights. Rahman urged strengthening religious harmony, tolerance, and mutual respect among people. He warned against forces attempting to create divisions and communal tensions. The Prime Minister distributed honorariums to priests and sebaits.

BRICS Summit 2026: Delhi, Central govt offices to remain closed on September 11
description: Central and Delhi government offices will close on September eleventh. This closure is due to the upcoming 18th BRICS Leaders Summit in New Delhi. Extensive security and logistical arrangements are being made for the international event. Leaders from approximately thirty countries will attend the summit and business forum. India is hosting the summit under its 2026 BRICS chairship.

title: ‘India lost to Ireland. Has cricket ended?’: Naqvi defends Pakistan's shake-up
description: Mohsin Naqvi, chairman of the Pakistan Cricket Board, stood firm regarding the team's latest performances and selection adjustments. He questioned whether a handful of defeats should spell the end of cricket in Pakistan. Noting other teams' challenges, he highlighted Pakistan's advancements in white-ball rankings while also tackling critiques from former players about the management's approach to team building.

title: Apple and Google rename Lake Ontario to Lake America; one app refuses Trump’s order
description: MapQuest's refusal to comply with a federal directive to rename Lake Ontario has landed the app at the peak of the US App Store charts. Unlike Google Maps and Apple Maps, which followed the presidential order, MapQuest experienced a remarkable boost, collecting over 1.5 million downloads in North America. The company is now shifting focus towards new features that users are eager for.

title: Wai Wai under FSSAI scanner: Firm told to stop production, 32,000kg stock seized
description: Food regulator FSSAI has ordered CG Foods India to stop producing Veg Bhujia Namkeen.  Inspections revealed hygiene lapses and unlicensed manufacturing of bhujia products.  The company was found re-processing floor-collected noodles without proper heat treatment.  FSSAI seized over 32,000 kg of stock and detained expired finished goods.  Legal proceedings have been initiated against CG Foods India for these violations.

Reflecting on his mentorship of Irfan Pathan, who admired his bowling style, Akram noted Pathan's impressive hat-trick against Pakistan. Ultimately, he reminded everyone that victories and defeats are part of the game, encouraging fans to let go of grudges.

description: India is enhancing its defense relationship with Belgium, focusing on increased security collaboration. The two countries have finalized agreement terms to advance military exchanges and training programs, showcasing commitment. Notably, the indigenous Zorawar light tank, capable of high-altitude warfare, incorporates a turret designed by Belgian firm John Cockerill. Produced in India through a joint venture, India has already ordered 59 Zorawar tanks to address regional security challenges.

title: China’s grey-zone game: Why India must prepare for ‘armed coexistence’

This rift within the Scheduled Caste community may stir up political complexities for the NDA government. The BJP must navigate the demands of anti-reservation activists and also its allies, who seek changes in reservation policy, even as it strives to maintain the balance of its electoral coalition pressures.

Surekha questioned the lack of consultation and the fairness of the decision. She defended her daughter and questioned actions against other Congress leaders. The former minister has not yet decided on her future political path.

Bezos got a special invite to ‘US exclusive Country Club’ but won’t get membership
description: Jeff Bezos and Lauren Sanchez attended an exclusive club event as guests.  Six months later, Bezos still awaits membership despite owning island properties.  Membership at Indian Creek Country Club requires more than significant financial investment.  Other prominent residents also face challenges in securing club membership.  The club's stringent approval process emphasizes member relationships and committee decisions.

title: Vanessa Trump, Tiger Woods lean on each other as their love grows, insider says
description: Vanessa Trump and Tiger Woods are standing strong for each other during difficult times. Vanessa has been battling breast cancer, while Tiger faced legal trouble after his DUI arrest. The couple has reportedly grown even closer while dealing with separate challenges. They have leaned on each other, providing significant strength during these periods. Their relationship has deepened as they navigate these trying moments together.

title: Building near airport? Centre plans faster height clearances, local-level NOCs
description: New reforms are set to expedite building height approvals in proximity to airports, streamlining the planning process for developers. They will now receive height permissions much earlier, especially in key metropolitan areas such as Delhi and Mumbai. Local urban bodies are expected to start issuing height no-objection certificates (NOCs), while automated digital tools will dramatically shorten project clearance timelines.

title: Travis Kelce’s $1.5M charity under scrutiny: Why did less go to charity?
description: Travis Kelce’s Eighty-Seven and Running Foundation is facing scrutiny over its reported spending between 2021 and 2024. The nonprofit raised $1.5 million and spent about $1.1 million, with $469,000 listed for management and $446,000 for charity. Kelce’s business manager Aaron Eanes disputed the figures, saying some charitable operational costs were misclassified. He said management fees dropped to zero in 2025 as the foundation works to improve transparency and governance.
